what: The hero photo panel flows vertically every 5s over 2s (downward — the next slide comes down from above), while the same photo row inside the shape window (a mask like a tooth outline) laid over the panel flows the opposite way (upward). Photos in the window are flipped horizontally and scaled 1.2x so a different part of the same photo shows through, and as the two rows stagger, the window border seems to slide over the photo. Both panel and window run two swiper (loop) instances at the same tempo.

options.[data-fx-part=main]: Photo panel — .swiper > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide type (required, and two or more slides)
options.[data-fx-part=window]: Shaped window — a photo strip of the same type as main (only the panel turns if absent)
options.[data-fx-part=pager]: Pagination dots (optional) — swiper pagination dots are drawn
options.dir: If horizontal, flows sideways, default vertical
options.reverse: If off, the plate flows straight too · if both, the window also reverses (both the same way), by default only the plate reverses
options.--fx-mask: Window shape (css) — url(image) or gradient, default none (window is the whole panel)
options.--fx-mask-size: Window-shaped size (css), default 100% — source PC 100% (the window cell overhangs the board to the left) · phone 80%
options.--fx-zoom: Scale of the photo inside the window (css), default 1.2 (larger when flipped horizontally)

note: The original sets pointer-events: none on the whole panel so it cannot be swiped by hand — the part also uses allowTouchMove: false so dragging is ignored and the page scrolls down even when swiped on a phone. The window-shaped artwork is not the original’s and is drawn by whoever uses the part.
